name: Morning Stretching — Shoulders & Hips
description: Weekly stretching rotation targeting shoulder/thoracic mobility and hip mobility. Three templates rotate across 7 days: Thoracic Priority, Hip Priority, and Integrated/Dynamic. Goes first in the morning stack before breathwork.

card_templates.name: Stretch: Thoracic Priority
card_templates.summary: Thoracic and shoulder openers with hip maintenance. Best before breathwork sessions.

payload.instructions: Thoracic Priority template (~12 min). Heavy on thoracic/shoulder opening, lighter hip maintenance. Breathe into every stretch — the rib expansion IS the stretch.

exercises.label: Cat-cow
exercises.detail: 10 slow reps. Initiate from the pelvis, not the neck. Let the movement wave up the spine. Exhale fully into cat.

exercises.label: Foam roller thoracic extension
exercises.detail: 60s. Lie lengthwise on roller, arms fall open, palms up. Each exhale lets shoulders drop further. Best position for opening breathing mechanics.

exercises.label: Thread the needle
exercises.detail: 30s each side. On all fours, slide one arm under the other, let shoulder drop to floor. Breathe into the stretch.

exercises.label: Open book
exercises.detail: 30s each side. Side-lying, knees at 90°. Top arm opens toward opposite side. Follow hand with eyes. Let gravity work.

exercises.label: Doorway pec stretch
exercises.detail: 30s each side. Forearm on doorframe at 90°. Step through. Do both elbow heights (low = upper pec, high = lower pec).

exercises.label: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.detail: 45s each side. Squeeze rear glute to posteriorly tilt pelvis BEFORE leaning forward. Don't arch low back.

exercises.label: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.detail: 10 reps (~90s). Sit with both knees at 90°. Rotate side to side. Keep spine tall, don't lean to compensate.

exercises.label: Supine spinal twist
exercises.detail: 30s each side. One knee across body, opposite shoulder stays on floor. Connects hip mobility to thoracic rotation.

card_templates.name: Stretch: Hip Priority
card_templates.summary: Deep hip work with thoracic maintenance. Best on easy/rest days.

payload.instructions: Hip Priority template (~14 min). Deep hip mobility work with thoracic maintenance. Don't push into pain — find the edge and breathe there.

exercises.label: Hip CARs
exercises.detail: 5 each direction, each side (~3 min). Standing, draw the biggest circle possible with the free knee. Slow and controlled.

exercises.label: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.detail: 10 reps (~90s). Both knees at 90°. Rotate side to side. Keep spine tall.

exercises.label: Pigeon pose (or figure-4 supine)
exercises.detail: 45s each side. If pigeon is too intense on the knee, do figure-4 lying on back. Breathe into the deep hip.

exercises.label: Frog stretch
exercises.detail: 45s. On all fours, widen knees, feet turned out. Rock gently forward and back. Don't bounce. Progress width over weeks.

exercises.label: Couch stretch
exercises.detail: 45s each side. Rear foot on wall behind you, front foot in lunge. Squeeze rear glute. Most aggressive hip flexor stretch.

exercises.label: Adductor rockback
exercises.detail: 30s each side. Half-kneeling, extend one leg straight to the side. Rock hips back toward heel of kneeling leg. Spine neutral.

exercises.label: Cat-cow
exercises.detail: 8 reps (~60s). Initiate from pelvis, wave up the spine. Exhale fully into cat.

exercises.label: Thread the needle
exercises.detail: 30s each side. Slide arm under, shoulder to floor. Breathe into the stretch.

card_templates.name: Stretch: Integrated/Dynamic
card_templates.summary: Balanced, shorter, activation-oriented. Best on hard training days as warm-up.

payload.instructions: Integrated/Dynamic template (~10 min). Balanced and quicker, activation-oriented. Functions as warm-up before hard training.

exercises.label: Cat-cow
exercises.detail: 8 reps (~60s). Initiate from pelvis, wave up the spine.

exercises.label: Hip CARs
exercises.detail: 3 each direction, each side (~2 min). Standing, biggest circles possible with free knee.

exercises.label: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.detail: 8 reps (~60s). Both knees at 90°, rotate side to side.

exercises.label: Half-kneeling hip flexor
exercises.detail: 30s each side. Glute squeeze first, then lean forward.

exercises.label: Open book
exercises.detail: 30s each side. Side-lying, top arm opens. Follow hand with eyes.

exercises.label: Wall slides (CARs)
exercises.detail: 8 reps (~60s). Back flat against wall, arms in goal post. Slide overhead maintaining wall contact.

exercises.label: Prone Y-T-W raises
exercises.detail: 6 reps each position (~90s). Face down, lift hands 2 inches, hold 3s. Thumbs up. Activation, not stretch.

exercises.label: Supine spinal twist
exercises.detail: 20s each side. Knee across body, opposite shoulder on floor. Let gravity work.

routine_specs.name: Morning Stretching — Shoulders & Hips
routine_specs.notes: Weekly stretching rotation. Three templates cycle across 7 days. Goes first in morning stack before breathwork. Thoracic priority before breathing-focused days, hip priority on easy/rest days, integrated/dynamic on hard training days.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Hard day (intervals). Short warm-up oriented session before hard effort. Move through each position with purpose.
Easy day. Deep hip work — you have time and bandwidth. Don't rush the holds.
Hard day (tempo). Short warm-up oriented session before tempo effort.
Easy day. Open breathing mechanics — alternate from yesterday's hip focus. Breathe deeply into every thoracic stretch.
Rest day. Biggest mobility session of the week — no run to rush to. Take extra time on tight areas.
Hard day (long run). Open rib cage for 2+ hours of breathing. Include hip maintenance stretches with intent.
Recovery day after long run. Balanced light session. Move gently, don't push range.
